user.title: HA MoviesDB
user.description: Enter your free themoviedb.org (TMDB) API key. You can create one at {url}.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate HA MoviesDB
reauth_confirm.description: themoviedb.org rejected the stored API key. Enter a new API key. You can create one at {url}.

error.invalid_auth: The API key was rejected by themoviedb.org.

abort.reauth_successful: The API key was updated successfully.

init.title: HA MoviesDB settings
init.description: Choose the region used for streaming availability, your own subscribed providers and up to 4 people the movies can be tagged for. The people are shown on the posters only when more than one is selected. Changing the region takes full effect the next time you open this dialog.

error.cannot_connect: Could not load region/provider data from themoviedb.org, using a fallback list.
error.too_many_persons: You can select at most 4 people.
